record.field: Get the migration status of a module for the known migration paths: status (fully_ported, migrate, port_commits, review_migration, replaced, moved_to_standard, moved_to_oca, moved_to_generic), the module it has been renamed to or replaced by, the last scanned commits and the PR url if any.
List the module renames/replacements declared in the database, with their review state: draft timelines are proposals pending review, not applied to the migration analysis yet.
Get the migration scan data of a module for a migration path: the process, the results of the last scan (commits to port, existing PR...) and the last scanned commits.

Declare that a module has been renamed or replaced by another one, starting from the next Odoo version. The proposal is created as a draft timeline, applied to the migration analysis only once confirmed by a human. When known, mention in 'note' the upstream change justifying it (e.g. the GitHub commit or PR URL) to help the reviewer.
Update a draft timeline proposal (new module, type or note). Confirmed timelines cannot be modified: they are managed by humans in the UI.
Delete a draft timeline proposal. Confirmed timelines cannot be deleted: they are managed by humans in the UI.

field.name: tool_ids
field.eval: [ (4, ref('migration_get_module_status_tool')), (4, ref('migration_list_timelines_tool')), (4, ref('migration_get_data_tool')), (4, ref('migration_create_timeline_tool')), (4, ref('migration_update_timeline_tool')), (4, ref('migration_delete_timeline_tool')), ]
